proposals.title: Master: fader 0.0 -> -2.5 dB so its peak -2.0 -> ~-4.5 dBFS (-3..-6 headroom)
proposals.detail: ALTERNATIVE: pull the Master bus for headroom. Don't do this AND the source trims -- trimming sources already lowers the Master.

manual_checks.check: Mono-sum the loudest section and verify kick, sub, and bass keep level and punch.
manual_checks.reason: The MCP snapshot cannot measure true phase correlation or mono cancellation.

kb_rules.recommendation: Flag wide or phase-risky main low-end elements as a compatibility concern, especially for club, car, phone, laptop, and mono playback.

Keep Low-End/Stereo Safety Assistant behavior read-only; report mixer pan, mixer stereo separation, low-end layering, and Master headroom as review findings or manual checks rather than automatic fixes.

safety_limits: Phrase as a strong recommendation, not an absolute rule.
Do not apply mid-side EQ or stereo changes unless a safe wrapper and readback path exist.
Do not claim true phase correlation, mono-sum cancellation, or sub-spectrum width from mixer metadata alone.
Do not apply stereo separation, mid-side EQ, plugin loading, rendering, saving, or mastering automation from this assistant.
Use playback or full-song watch peaks for hot low-end and Master-headroom findings when level evidence matters.

manual_checks.check: Manually inspect stereo enhancers, Haas delays, chorus, and mid-side EQ on low-end tracks or buses.
manual_checks.reason: Mixer pan/stereo_sep metadata cannot prove whether sub energy is present in the side channel.

kb_policy_refs.recommendation: Treat Master peaks above 0 dBFS as render/output clipping risk; treat insert-track peaks as diagnostic context rather than automatic failure.
Treat Master peaks near or above 0 dBFS as output/render clipping or headroom risk and make them high priority.
Treat insert-track peaks above 0 dBFS as headroom, balance, or stem-render risk rather than the same failure class as Master/output clipping.
Prefer source-track or bus trims before treating a Master fader reduction as the default fix.
When headroom is low, prefer trimming hot source tracks or relevant buses before treating Master fader reduction as the default fix.
EQ, compression, limiting, reverb, delay, and mastering suggestions may configure already-loaded plugins only through safe wrappers.
